notes.title: Free Music Update on Sept 24 — Shirobon + Future Funk Squad
notes.notes:
[p]Hi all,[/p][p][/p][p]On September 24th I'll be updating all versions of Beat Hazard to include some great new tracks.[/p][p][/p][p]First we have 5 amazing chip-tune tracks from [url="https://open.spotify.com/artist/2OgP0RGmDrXN9kOWRNfEuE"]Shirobon[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I've also been working with [url="https://open.spotify.com/artist/3zU9fuxpRmXdJk7nyTe8u9"]Future Funk Squad[/url] who have worked with Nine Inch Nails, Sia and U2. They have made an exclusive track for Beat Hazard, and I'm really excited for everyone to play it. I'm so privileged to be able to work with a top flight artist![/p][p][/p][p]On Sept 24th, Beat Hazard returns to PlayStation. Details [url="https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10011890"]here[/url] 
[/p][p]I'm gaging interest on a Steam release of Beat Hazard Arcade. It would have full VR support, and be a streamlined Arcade Beat Hazard experience. It would have some new weapons and enemies, and focus on community leaderboards. I'm interested to hear some feedback. [/p][p]
Happy Hazarding![/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Steve.[/p]

notes.title: V 1.311 Start up time fix
notes.notes:
Hi,

Start up time fix:
I've altered the sign in order so the game get the time from the internet right at the start. If this fails, it will use your system time. If your system time is wrong, then there will be an error when the game tries to talk to AWS. This error should now be properly shown on screen instead of just crashing (as was the case before)

I've also updated the version of Steam Lib to the latest version.

Cheers,
Steve.

notes.title: New Zen+ difficulty and gameplay update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33564160/d9b34d7d1b8ead34dc8dd8971a6dd97ae37d8afe.jpg[/img]

Hi all,

A new update has just dropped that adds a new difficulty level. Gameplay improvements have been made and a number of major bugs have been fixed:

Gameplay:
- Zen+ difficulty. More ships. +30% enemy HP. Good luck!
- Each player ship can now have only 1 Start Multiplier. This has been offset be increasing the value gained from the 'More Multiplier' perk. 
- Ship stats have been re-balanced. This means most player ships should 'feel' better. However, because of the way the procedural system works, some ships might need a 're-roll' and therefore might change quite a bit.

Bug fixes:
- Hangar screen can now handle unlimited ships. 
- Random crash on Game Over screen should now be fixed.

Stats:
- Press 'D' in the options screen will dump your high score data to the debug.txt file. Handy to find the tracks with the best / highest score rate.

A big thank you to Ceph and the players on the discord server for suggestions, feedback and testing.

Cheers,
Steve

notes.title: Unreal & VR Version
notes.notes:
The Unreal and VR version is now on the main branch.

You will be able to select the version you want to play when you launch the game.
The Unreal version can be played with or without VR, you should also be able to swap between versions without issue.

The Unreal version is still in Beta, so please report any bugs / issues to the forums.

Both versions will kept up to date.

The reason for the Unreal port was not only for VR but it will also create an easier path for a console port.

Thanks for all the feedback and support.
Cheers,
Steve

notes.title: Scoring change
notes.notes:
The latest update has some scoring changes.

The global multiplier has been increased from 1.5 to 2.0 so everyone will get higher scores. This means previous unreachable high scores can now be beaten.

Playing with no perk weapons will also give you a 5% score bonus.

There is a fix the make sure each play of a track produces the same outcome.

I've also fixed an issue with Open Mic track ID mixing up some of the data.

notes.title: V1.043
notes.notes:
Note: These changes have required a reset of the per song scores and per song leaderboards. 

- Added Global recent tracks list. Here you can see the recent tracks other people have been playing
- Click on the 'copy to clipboard' to copy the track details to the clipboard. You can then paste this in Spotify, or elsewhere, to quickly find that track.
- Track hashing is now less picky. All tracks are now and lower case and will match on a duration of +/- 5 seconds. (This change of hash system is the reason for the per song score reset as track will now map ti different hash values)
- Tried to improve open mic detection success. The code now listens for 15s instead of the previous 8s.
- Open Mic tracks should now spawn the same as local tracks given the same song.


Note: The result of the next feature vote was Articulated Bosses. So that will be the next major feature I'll be working on.

notes.title: V1.001 Update
notes.notes:
Hi all, new build is up:

I've tried to address the open mic problems some players are having:

- Fixed crash when using 'Open Mic Settings'

- All 'loopback' audio devices are now added to the desktop audio list, this include Speakers, Headphones and Headsets

- Added warning if input device has > 2 channels. It will still play, but the ID system doesn't currently work with surround sound.

- Added a warning if input frequency is > 48khz. If you get this warning, can you report back is the track ID system worked?

Steve
